newsitem.title: USA: US aluminum center shipments up 8.5 pct in Jan-Apr.
newsitem.headline: US aluminum center shipments up 8.5 pct in Jan-Apr.

text.p: U.S. aluminum service center shipments rose 8.5 percent in the first four months of the year compared to the same period in 1996 while inventory, year-on-year were relatively unchanged, the National Association of Aluminum Distributors said.
But according to the association's three-month moving average index, shipments in April declined to 143.1 points from 146.1 in March, but were up from 133.1 points in April 1996.
Inventory rose to 130.2 points in April from 129.1 in March, representing 3.0 months of inventory.
